parameters.query: WITH week_range AS ( SELECT date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)::date AS week_start, (date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)::date + INTERVAL '6 days')::date AS week_end ) SELECT i.id AS internship_id, i.supervisor_id, e.id AS employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.company_email AS intern_email, sup.company_email AS supervisor_email, COALESCE(SUM(l.hours_worked), 0)::numeric(10,2) AS weekly_hours FROM public.internships i JOIN public.employees e ON e.id = i.employee_id AND e.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN public.employees sup ON sup.user_id = i.supervisor_id AND sup.deleted_at IS NULL CROSS JOIN week_range w LEFT JOIN public.intern_daily_logs l ON l.internship_id = i.id AND l.log_date >= w.week_start AND l.log_date <= w.week_end WHERE i.status = 'active' GROUP BY i.id, i.supervisor_id, e.id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.company_email, sup.company_email ORDER BY i.supervisor_id NULLS LAST, e.last_name, e.first_name;
